button.name: action_send_all_for_approval
button.help: Send every current draft on this contract — income, direct cost, operating exp, timesheets, budget and commission — in a single approval request. Approval covers exactly those items, once each; it does not leave the contract or month open.

button.name: action_print_all_invoices
button.help: Print every invoice of this contract in one PDF. Each invoice keeps its own page(s), number, VAT totals and QR code — they are not merged into a single document.

field.help: CR2 G3 — how the salesperson earns commission on this contract. Rate is looked up on Payroll & Accounting Setup → Sales Person Commission Rules by employee. Percentage modes are gated: Actual Profit must be > 0 for a payout.

field.name: start_date
field.help: Start of this record's period. Drives the auto-name (Client — MM/YYYY), the PRO/YYYY/MM/NNNN reference series, and the one-record-per-client-month-project rule.

field.name: end_date
field.help: End of this record's period. Defaults to the last day of the Start Date month on every Start Date change; editable, and required while the record is unlocked.

field.name: contract_month
field.help: First day of Start Date's month. Uniqueness key; not for display.

field.name: accounting_date
field.help: Legacy mirror of Start Date (CR3-FINAL P1). Kept for backwards compatibility with existing filters and saved views.

field.name: due_date
field.help: Legacy. The Accounting Date + 45 days auto-fill was removed in CR3-FINAL P1; existing values preserved.

field.name: analytic_distribution

page.name: project_expenses
page.div:
Direct Cost (COGS) lines: Worker wages, client commission, transportation, equipment rent, building rent, utility exp. Each line creates a Vendor Bill when you click Create Bill and posts to COGS on the Billing Summary.
Note: Direct Cost bills can only be posted after the contract has at least one customer invoice — the bill's Payment Reference is composed from the invoice number.

Multi-line bills (optional): click Create New Bill Block, pick the vendor, add every Direct Cost line for that vendor, then the block's Create Bill produces ONE vendor bill with all of them. For a single-line bill, use the per-line Create Bill below exactly as before.

Note: percentage modes require Actual Profit above zero — no profit, no commission. Once the bill is posted the amount is frozen so it can't drift from the GL.
